KOTA MAKASSAR.text: CCM tickets in Kota Makassar increased on 12–13 September, mainly contributed by sites in Biringkanaya and Tamalanrea districts, following a backbone FO cut.

HALMAHERA SELATAN.text: Complaints in Halmahera Selatan increased by +21 tickets (+150%), aligned with the SKKL FO cut on ME-D7-LBH (Eth-Trunk25) – SME-D7-OBI and ME-D7-LBH (Eth-Trunk23) – SME2-D7-OBI. Update 28 Sep 2026: issue resolved after 9d 16h 14m 59s downtime.
